scope: Focused static DEX study only; original APK was never executed, installed, or used to bypass billing. No assets, decompiled source or instruction listings were copied into app/repository. These findings describe Android1.1.0/versionCode4, not current iOS.
offsetConvention: codeItemOffsetHex is absolute within classes.dex. Relative instruction offsets cited below are byte offsets from code-item instruction start, which is codeItemOffset+16.

callgraphToCreditMethod.callerDescriptor: (Lcom/kanta/plainwalk/walk/c; Lo7/h; Lo7/g; Z Z LL8/a; LX0/s; I)V

projection.proof: Origin field names verified by Lt7/v.toString; TrackPoint.a/b names verified by TrackPoint.toString; c uses Ll7/j.a=(first/second cos)*third and LA5/G.a=(first-second)*third+fourth. Returned Lt7/t fields preserve constructor input order. Null origin returns(0,0).
projection.normalization: No longitude-wrap normalization in this projection method. All formulas assume finite ordinary coordinates.

cellKey.formula: floor(x/12) + colon + floor(y/12); mathematical floor, then Java double-to-int conversion.

segmentCredit.precondition: If projected hypot(b-a)<=0 OR caller distanceWeight<=0, return credit0/newCells0 with no state change.
segmentCredit.sampleLocations: For j=0..N-1, t=(j+0.5)/N; sample=a+(b-a)*t. Endpoints are not sampled.
state: a: persistent mutable cell-count HashMap, initialized by copying provided Map.
b: current-epoch HashSet; c: previous sampled cell key; d: previous cell newness Boolean. Names a/b/c/d are retained, not guessed original method names.
On entering a key different from c, set d to whether key is absent from a BEFORE insertion; count it as newCells if absent.
On first encounter in HashSet b, increment a[key] by1. Further samples in same epoch do not increment its count.
For every sample, including samples that continue previous call in the same cell, increment newSampleCount when d is true.
Return Credit.pioneered=distanceWeight*newSampleCount/N and Credit.newCells=newly absent cell entries. Semantic output labels are proven by Lt7/G.toString, not invented.

epochReset.effect: Clear HashSet b, previous key c and newness d. Preserve global count map a. Constructor copies initial map and starts empty epoch.
epochReset.consequence: Same-cell backtracking may still earn credit until the sampled cell changes or b() resets. This algorithm is not backtrack-invariant or strictly collinear-subdivision-invariant.

live.inputMeaning: Lt7/k.toString proves lat/lon/accuracy/time/course/speed fields. Lt7/n.a reads Android Location latitude/longitude/getAccuracy/time and forwards to c.p; missing accuracy becomes-1.

gates.condition: previous accepted fix exists AND B4.b(previous,current)<4m

gates.effect: Increment TrackPoint leg index, set distance weight0, append current fix without connected distance/credit

live.weight: When prior fix exists and positive connected distance remains, B4.b(previous.lat/lon,current.lat/lon) is passed as H.a third argument at relative0xfa.
live.output: Credit.a added to TrackSession.f at0x10e..0x116; distance weight added to TrackSession.e at0x106..0x10a. toString proves f=pioneered/e=distance. Last accepted-fix field k assigned at0x248.
live.limits: Outer c.p recording/auto-start branches were not fully reconstructed; these gates describe x once called, not every possible location ingestion path.

offline.process: Create fresh H; iterate sessions in supplied order. Call H.b at each session start. For adjacent points, call B4.b/projection/H.a only when TrackPoint.leg fields equal. Sum credit; append min(sum,session.distance) per session. Return H and list of session credits.
offline.proofOffsets: sessionReset0x4e; leg equality0x88..0x90; geodesicWeight0xb8; projection0xc8/0xd8; credit0xe0; cap0x104..0x118
offline.limits: No timestamp sorting inside this routine; input ordering belongs to caller. Leg change skips a pair but does not itself call H.b, so last-key state persists across skipped pairs.

distanceWeightRoutine.finding: Ellipsoidal iterative inverse-distance structure consistent with Vincenty; identical-coordinate branch returns0. After100 nonconvergent iterations, a spherical haversine/atan2 fallback is used.
distanceWeightRoutine.limit: No original-runtime numeric oracle; full ellipsoid expression not independently reimplemented here. Comparison tools can isolate cell logic using explicit provided distance weights.

originAndPersistence.restore: c.t() @0x41304c relative0x130..0x172 restores Origin from PersistedData.c/d and H from PersistedData.b; toString proves names originLat/originLon/cellCounts.
originAndPersistence.initialization: c.p(Fix) @0x412cdc relative0x10..0x26 assigns origin from delivered fix only when origin is null. This occurs before downstream x acceptance gates; do not call it first accepted recorded fix. c.r import path also creates missing origin from its first imported TrackPoint at0x274..0x290.
originAndPersistence.save: c.J() @0x410268 relative0x48..0x7e copies H global cellCounts and origin lat/lon for PersistedData update.
originAndPersistence.sessionStart: c.g() @0x411fe4 relative0x98..0xa8 calls H.b and clears previous accepted fix k.
limits: No routine recentering within inspected paths; full app-wide reset/migration paths were not exhaustively traced.
Pause/resume service code also resets epoch and reconstructs session-touched cells; full correctness of all service-action branches not proven.
Daily allocation/time-zone split not established; H itself contains no dates and offline routine returns per-session values.
Current iOS may use a different algorithm; no parity guarantee is inferred from these old Android findings.

independentImplementationDifferences: Current iOS/Web approximation uses a global latitude-row grid,111195.08 scaling and per-new-cell maximum16-direction passage diameter. Verified old Android uses stored local origin,111320/110540 scaling and weighted midpoint sample counts.
Current haversine distance differs from old Android iterative ellipsoidal B4.b in normal cases.

Current backtrack/subdivision invariance goals differ from observed old Android current-new-cell continuation. Do not silently replace a user existing distance history or claim identical iOS calculations.
actionableNextStep: Keep current defaults unchanged. An isolated read-only developer comparison can accept explicit origin, original ordered sessions/legs and provided segment distance weights, report old-Android-spec sample credit separately from current approximation, and label data/version/algorithm limits. Exact iOS default replacement requires current-iOS evidence and migration design.
